verdicts.rationale: The resource partially meets 1.P.EICC.1.e. Students discuss the text with peers through multiple Turn and Talk and Think-Pair-Share exchanges (e.g., "What happened in the beginning of the story?" with student responses like "Monica wants to play with the moon, so she asks her Papa to get it for her"), meeting the discuss-texts clause. Four of six clauses are not met.
